text.aria-label: Title text 'Where the overcast-minus-clear gap rises, solar capacity has risen'

g.text: Where the overcast-minus-clear gap rises, solar capacity has risen

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Line (MW): the mean power from 10:00 to 14:00 UTC, in MW, on overcast days (daily clear- sky index 0.3 or less) minus that on clear days (0.8 or more), pooled over 8 weeks. A positive gap means less power is drawn on clear days, so solar output is offsetting demand. Scope: April to September only (the sun is too low in winter); days inside a logged switching closure are removed; 8 Primary substations; windows with fewer than 3 days of either kind give no line.'
